name: breakhis-prior-centered-v1

normalization.zero_policy: divide by max(norm, epsilon); exact zero stays zero
normalization.canonical_center: per view: field mean per support case, then case means within each head class, then equal mean over head classes

head_specific.binary: equal benign-case and malignant-case group centers
head_specific.malignant: equal four malignant-type centers; benign cases excluded

support_policy: same original class/case/field density weights and uniform head-class priors as reference; no changes beyond origin before L2
fitting_diagnostic: leave entire query case out before centers, weights and support counts; query truth does not determine centers
validation_policy: fitting support only; no validation/excluded labels or fields in learned centers
duplicate_scope: 40 direct candidate definitions and80 role archives repeat across modes; structural counts are not independent observations or guaranteed distinct file hashes
selection: earliest maximum end-to-end mean15-subset macroF1 among4shared temperatures per named mode/arm
interpretation: one supervised cosine-geometry ablation, not a correction of invalid prior mathematics; original shared center remains valid; sparse class centroids may increase variance; no novelty or95% guarantee; all reused provider-case scores and duplicate controls disclosed
family_opportunity_scope: eight logical mode-temperature slots per arm; duplicated direct controls leave four unique direct and eight unique dual choices
